discovered.method: web search: 'life coach Boise Idaho solo practice website'

curation.reasoning: Squarespace confirmed via Server header and CNAME (ext-cust.squarespace.com). The site ships Squarespace's default commerce CSS/JS (sqs-cart, product-quick-view) and a /cart route, but there's no actual store behind it — /shop 404s, and the only 'shop'-adjacent link is an affiliate 'recommended products' page that opens off-site. Booking runs through Acuity (resourcequeen.as.me), an external scheduling link, not a bundled CRM/funnel platform. No login/member area in use despite the account-core CSS being template boilerplate present on every Squarespace site. Performance 59 is a real-but-mild story (mobile load is sluggish, not dramatic), so the stronger pitch here is the dollar one: same non-commerce Squarespace cost as Bravely Rooted ($275/yr) for a business-card-plus-Acuity-link site, with $138/yr savings and a clean same-day DNS migration.

notes: Life, career, and health coaching (ICF Professional Certified Coach). No public email or phone found on homepage, About, or Contact pages — only an external booking link (resourcequeen.as.me) and a mention of text/WhatsApp for between-session support with no number given. Squarespace-hosted (CNAME ext-cust.squarespace.com, Server: Squarespace).
